environment.description: NestJS microservice deployed on ECS Fargate in an isolated VPC (10.0.0.0/16) with no internet gateway, no NAT gateway, and no public subnets. Service is exposed exclusively through an AWS PrivateLink interface VPC endpoint (com.amazonaws.vpce.us-east-1.vpce-svc-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890). The VPC endpoint service has a VPC endpoint policy restricting access to three specific AWS account IDs via aws:PrincipalAccount condition. The endpoint uses TCP proxy protocol v2 which introduces variable-length header processing adding 50-200μs of non-deterministic latency per request. The NLB target group has cross-zone load balancing enabled distributing across 3 AZs (us-east-1a, 1b, 1c) with connection draining. Security groups on the ENIs only allow ingress from the VPC CIDR on port 3000. There is no VPC peering, no transit gateway attachment, and no Direct Connect virtual interface associated with this VPC.

config.exposure: AWS PrivateLink VPC Endpoint Service only
